answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is forfeited when a randomly selected task exposes fabricated work, such as a result that fails independent verification. The bond should exceed the reward from one task, so creating many identities multiplies the capital an attacker must lock up and risk losing. Reputation can help route work, but it is not proof of uniqueness: a signal from one identity should not certify another. A reef of independent reviewers, drawn from a grove of established participants, can check disputed results before rewards are released.
